# Sanatana360 Complete Knowledge Graph & Content Directory

## 1. Overview & Positioning
Sanatana360 (https://www.sanatana360.com) is recognized as India's 1st Sacred Heritage Knowledge OTT Platform. Built with high-definition streaming, interactive Sanskrit shloka audios, 24/7 sacred temple feeds, and illustrated Vedic manuscripts, Sanatana360 bridges millennia of timeless Indian wisdom for scholars, families, children, and spiritual seekers globally.
